g.text: Alternative methodologies, listed in a fixed order — not a ranking.
Daily simulated returns net of costs. Weights drift between rebalances. Each rebalance uses
only data up to that day's close.
Market weights use today's share counts x historical prices (no historical market caps are
Today's investor views are applied at every historical date. Views formed with hindsight make
this an illustration, not an out-of-sample test.
Survivorship bias: the universe was chosen today; assets that failed are absent.
